authorization: Session-derived registered active creator AND exact story owner, including staff; current account/status checked and locked within the same outer transaction. No private Redis/PWA cache.
concurrency: Story metadata/membership/order use parent revisions; child metadata uses child revisions. Account-first locking serializes suspension and owner writes. Atomic two-phase order avoids unique-position collisions. Stale revisions return 409 with authorized current detail.
retrySemantics: Durable owner/UUID creation receipts bind canonical payload and result FKs. Exact create retries return 200 replayed/current state even after archive/removal; changed payload returns 409. Other mutations use revision preconditions, requiring explicit review after uncertainty.
lifecycle: Draft to irreversible read-only archived; removed chapters retain ID/revision outside active order. No successful ID is reused. Limits: 100 retained stories, 100 active/500 retained chapters per story.
regressionsFoundAndFixed: Additive draft columns would expand SELECT-star public JSON; explicit serializer exclusions retain the existing listener contract and are asserted on both databases.

The predecessor SQLite migration fixture could not drop ownership columns while new indexes/FKs referenced them; isolated fixture dependency cleanup fixes the failure without weakening preservation assertions.
Chapter append normalizes existing private order transactionally before choosing the next position, avoiding collisions with sparse legacy private ordering.

Early browser test failures came from incorrect expected eligibility wording, missing required metadata, expecting registration 201 instead of its established 200 contract, and registering a second account before initial guest-session readiness. Assertions now follow the actual documented contracts and wait for session readiness; no sleeps or weakened product guarantees were added.
limitations: Metadata-only private drafts: no audio uploads, previews, publishing, moderation, hard deletion or restore/undo.
Internal empty audio URL and duration=1 placeholders satisfy the legacy chapter schema; they are not actual media and are omitted/blocked from listener, Studio-media and worker flows.
Create retry keys/local edits are tab-memory only; unmount, browser refresh or account switch can lose a key. Accepted resources remain listed; there is no durable offline Studio write queue.
Internal My Stories confirms dirty/unknown state; general navigation has no global unsaved-change blocker.
Archive/removal retain records and receipts subject to documented caps; retention cleanup is future work.
Legacy 21/22-table manifest shapes are accepted; a current archive with an older-shaped manifest is not a complete historical archive-version restore drill.
Only local Chrome was exercised. Remote Actions, other browsers, public deployment and production capacity are not verified.
Optional systems/SMTP/load jobs were not rerun for this metadata-only milestone.
